description: This file contains controller functions for handling card-related API endpoints in a Node.js application. It includes methods for retrieving user cards, fetching a single card, changing a card's PIN, and updating card limits, utilizing a Card model and utility functions for error handling.

methods.name: getMyCards
methods.description: Retrieves all cards owned by the authenticated user.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Fetches a single card by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: changePin
methods.description: Updates the PIN of a specified card if it belongs to the user.

methods.name: changeLimits
methods.description: Updates the online and withdrawal limits of a specified card.
